reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited paragraphs contain no MFN obligation running against the Licensee (our party): p0078 is a fixed 33% revenue-share, p0076 is a Licensor-granted rebate in our favour, and neither references terms given to third parties as a benchmark.

The only third-party comparison (p0094 — Revisions made available when generally released to other licensees) benefits us, consistent with the rule's instruction to mark Vendor-granted best-terms provisions compliant and not redline.
No redline text was altered and no comment was emitted, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; deterministic checks are empty, so nothing contradicts the rationale.
Rationale accurately maps to the preferred position (no MFN burden on Customer) and does not over-flag any acceptable clause.
